name: Quran Daily
description: Free, sourced, offline-first Islamic reference: Quran, hadith, duas, prayer times, Qibla, Salah tutorials, Hijri calendar, and the 99 Names of Allah. Every ayah, hadith, dua, and translation cites its source.

resources.name: Quran
resources.description: All 114 surahs and 6,236 ayat in Uthmani script with English and Indonesian translations, transliteration, tafsir, and verse audio.

resources.name: Hadith
resources.description: The six canonical Sunni collections (Kutub as-Sittah) from Sunnah.com, with authenticity grading where available.

resources.name: Duas
resources.description: Authentic supplications sourced from Hisnul Muslim, categorised by occasion.

resources.name: 99 Names of Allah
resources.description: Asma-ul-Husna with pronunciation, meaning, and Quranic context.

resources.name: Prayer Times
resources.description: Per-city prayer times with configurable calculation methods and Qibla direction.
